title: Sum of N Numbers
problem: The first line of input is a positive integer N. The second line has N integers separated by spaces. Print their sum.
starter_code:
# Read N, then read N integers from the next line.
# Print their sum.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about reading N first, then a separate line holding N numbers together.
hints.2: input().split() on the second line gives you a list of strings - convert each to int, then use sum() or a loop with a running total.
hints.3: n = int(input()); nums = map(int, input().split()); print(sum(nums))

failure_explanation: N on its own line and the numbers on the next line are two separate input() calls - don't try to read them all from one line. Also make sure every value is converted to int before adding; summing strings concatenates them instead.
